versions.changelog: Security: pre-flight canonicalization withholds ALL operator headers and refuses operator bodies cross-origin (URL_POLICY); entity-headers model for internal bodies on 307/308; spark/ subdir perms migration. 777 tests.

Security: L402 SSRF guard (per-hop redirect validation, pre-flight allowlist, origin-aware credential stripping), 0600/0700 secure state files with legacy migration, https/wss endpoint validation, preimage suppression via --include-preimage. 764 tests.
Breez SDK 0.25.0 (zero-fallback upgrade, stdout guard revalidated), port-range hardening, budget rolling-window doc, README token wording, AGENTS.md ops notes. 748 tests.

Non-custodial (Spark) account support (credential-free LNURL receive + seed-gated spark-* via Breez SDK); fail-closed L402 spending and env-only API key (breaking); SSRF guard at the network boundary; structural BOLT-11 validation; seed checksum fails closed; owner-only wallet-state dir. 474 tests passing.

1.8.0: Security hardening — L402 auto-pay now fails closed (requires explicit budget + domain allowlist); --force no longer bypasses budget/domain checks; BLINK_API_KEY read from environment only (shell rc files never read); L402 root key no longer printed to stderr
